Class GameStateDtoBuilder.CardToDtoVisitor

java.lang.Object
model.GameStateDtoBuilder.CardToDtoVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardVisitor
Enclosing class:
GameStateDtoBuilder
private static class GameStateDtoBuilder.CardToDtoVisitor extends Object implements CardVisitor
Builds a CardDto from a card by visiting it. Each card type maps to its own presentation payload — subtype label, era and a short human-readable detail string — so the rendering layer can display cards without knowing their domain classes.

    • visit

      public void visit(CharacterCard card)
      Fallback for any character role not handled by a dedicated overload. Reaching this method signals a concrete CharacterCard subtype was added without a matching visit overload, so it fails fast rather than emitting a mislabeled DTO.
      Specified by:
      visit in interface CardVisitor
      Parameters:
      card - the unhandled character card
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - always, naming the offending subtype
